001package org.clafer.lsp;
002
003import java.util.concurrent.ExecutionException;
004import org.eclipse.lsp4j.jsonrpc.Launcher;
005import org.eclipse.lsp4j.launch.LSPLauncher;
006import org.eclipse.lsp4j.services.LanguageClient;
007
008/**
009 * Runs the Clafer language server on stdin and stdout: {@code clafer-ls},
010 * or {@code java -jar clafer-ls.jar}. Nothing else may write to stdout, so
011 * messages go to stderr.
012 */
013public final class Main {
014
015    private Main() {
016    }
017
018    /**
019     * @return the name, the version and the build date, as the other Clafer
020     * tools print them: {@code clafer-ls v0.6.0.2026-11-26}
021     */
022    static String version() {
023        return "clafer-ls v" + number();
024    }
025
026    /**
027     * @return the version and the build date, {@code 0.6.0.2026-11-26}, from
028     * the version.properties that Maven fills in
029     */
030    static String number() {
031        java.util.Properties p = new java.util.Properties();
032        try (java.io.InputStream in = Main.class.getResourceAsStream("version.properties")) {
033            p.load(in);
034        } catch (java.io.IOException | NullPointerException e) {
035            return "unknown";
036        }
037        return p.getProperty("version") + "." + p.getProperty("releasedate");
038    }
039
040    public static void main(String[] args) throws InterruptedException {
041        for (String a : args) {
042            if (a.equals("--version")) {
043                System.out.println(version());
044                return;
045            }
046            if (a.equals("--help") || a.equals("-h")) {
047                System.out.println("clafer-ls: the Clafer language server, over stdin and stdout (LSP).");
048                System.out.println("Start it from an editor's LSP client; it takes no options but --version.");
049                return;
050            }
051            // --stdio, which some clients pass, is what the server does anyway
052        }
053        // the JSON-RPC messages are the only output on stdout
054        java.io.PrintStream out = System.out;
055        System.setOut(System.err);
056        ClaferLanguageServer server = new ClaferLanguageServer(System::exit);
057        Launcher<LanguageClient> launcher = LSPLauncher.createServerLauncher(server, System.in, out);
058        server.connect(launcher.getRemoteProxy());
059        try {
060            launcher.startListening().get();
061        } catch (ExecutionException e) {
062            System.err.println("clafer-ls: " + e.getCause());
063            System.exit(1);
064        }
065    }
066}
